purpose: Correct the historical observable ordering defect without redesigning the frozen 005B science, then test whether the original promoted findings are falsified or materially weakened.

ordering_defect.reason: timestamp is block time at one-second resolution and tx_hash is not an observable sequencing key; log_index is block-global and block_number establishes inter-block order.
ordering_defect.upstream_note: The Polygon OrderFilled decoder exposes block_number and log_index before the canonical trades schema projects block_number away. The correction must therefore use a block-number enrichment sourced from the upstream decoded/on-chain fill layer, not infer block_number from tx_hash or timestamp.

required_sequence: Recover block_number for the exact frozen 005B economic-fill population from the upstream decoded/on-chain fill source using immutable fill keys.
Before any corrected feature build, quantify shared timestamp/block groups and exact old-vs-corrected rank changes at market, event and family scopes.
Quantify feature/target observations whose realised values or label endpoints differ solely because of ordering.
Rebuild the frozen 005B feature/target matrices with only the ordering correction.
Re-evaluate only the original parent promoted scalar candidates and original selected model specifications/hyperparameters. No new candidate may enter.
Run the corrected HOLDOUT comparison only as post-hoc falsification. It cannot promote, upgrade, reconfirm, or create an alpha claim.

audit_requirements.mapping_gate: 100% of frozen 005B economic rows must map to a non-null upstream block_number; any key conflict or timestamp disagreement is a hard failure.

interpretation_rule.movement_material_survival: Report whether each original clock realised-movement model still beats every original named baseline on corrected HOLDOUT MAE, whether family-level MAE improvement remains positive in all five families, and whether the original hierarchical bootstrap metric remains positive. This is a falsification diagnostic only.
interpretation_rule.event_direction_survival: Report corrected sign/accuracy/bootstrap behavior for the original event-time directional candidates/models only; no replacements are allowed.

downstream_rule.if_movement_materially_survives: Carry the unchanged movement hypothesis forward for fresh confirmation on DATA-003 / the actual mapped 2026 universe.
